notes.title: Elements Update – September 2025
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! It has been a while since our last Steam update (back in November 2023) and a lot has happened since then. We have been keeping our Kickstarter backers closely updated, but we realized the Steam community has missed some of the progress. This post is meant to catch you up on some of the big milestones. Over the next little while we will also be sharing smaller updates to highlight features and content you may have missed, so the Steam community is fully up to date.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Moving to Unreal Engine 5.5[/b][/h3][p]We have successfully migrated [i]Elements[/i] to Unreal Engine 5.5! This shift has unlocked better tools, smoother workflows, and stronger performance across the board. Most importantly, it gives us access to Unreal’s Procedural Content Generation (PCG) framework, which has already helped us prototype and populate the world faster while keeping everything handcrafted and full of detail.[/p][h3][/h3][hr][/hr][h3]
[b]Closed Alpha Launch[/b][/h3][p]Since January, [i]Elements[/i] has been in Closed Alpha with players actively exploring Elemythia. The feedback has been incredibly valuable, helping us refine combat, polish systems, and make the world feel more alive. We are still fixing bugs and implementing some other features. Before Early Access release we would like to release a public demo so that more players can experience [i]Elements[/i] and share feedback.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Character Customization[/b][/h3][p]You can now personalize Nyah and Beckett with different hair styles, clothing options, and skin tones while still keeping them true to their story and role in Elemythia. This balance between personalization and narrative identity is really important to us, and we would love to hear what kinds of customization options you would like to see added.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="EijtS1XXjp0;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h3][b]UI and Progression Improvements[/b][/h3][p]The UI is evolving! The updated inventory system now tracks elemental stats so you can see how your gear interacts with your attunement. We have also added a Biome Progression screen, letting you track your journey through each region and see which Elemental Cuffs you have unlocked. These Cuffs are powerful relics that grant traversal and puzzle-solving abilities tied to the elements.[/p][p]We’ve also improved basic tooltips to help clarify item details and effects. While these features still need some visual polish, they're an important step toward a more intuitive and informative interface. Expect continued refinement as we work to make the UI both functional and visually satisfying.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="I1th1EhTk24;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][previewyoutube="iZctkYHS7gQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][previewyoutube="zQRsqNoJC_s;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/c424d1a827b2f1cae464fa105294c4cad3da1902.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Climbing & Ladders[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Ledge climbing and ladders have been part of Elements from the beginning, but until recently, they didn’t work in split-screen mode. We’re thrilled to share that they’re now fully functional and more refined, allowing seamless multiplayer exploration. Not everything will be climbable, but we plan to identify climbable ledges with a different color or a "painted" texture. If you have any other ideas on ways to identify climbable ledges we are all ears![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ilKPDETvDZA;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h3][b]World[/b][/h3][p]Below is a screenshot of some of the Nature Biome, a large part of the world we’ve been working on. The Nature Biome is about 1/8 of the map. The map is quite large, but I think the strategic placement of landmarks and points of interest will make navigation easy. We already have options to toggle the minimap and compass on or off, so those who want to rely solely on their sense of direction and clues from NPCs can do so. Those who prefer a little more guidance can use the map, compass, and minimap markers.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/4777def7939f044b737f1e8681700da5007fff80.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Runes[/b][/h3][p]We had some custom runes created, and I think they really add to Elemythia’s unique look and feel. These runes will mark points of interest or locations where you need to bring keys to unlock additional areas.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/105aca438f2bb61edc549e6d9aca8e645ee17cab.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/5c02e822c59071cc5432359988c2f5bc14d8ad8c.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Monument Update[/b][/h3][p]We thought the monuments would fit better into Elemythia if we masked the Stone Keeper names in the Elemythian language. They will be displayed in native Elemyta until you interact with the monument, after which the names in English will be revealed.[/p][p]We also added some functionality to the monuments. Now, once you find a monument and unlock it, you’ll receive a special reward. One idea we had was to provide a legendary crafting ingredient that, when combined with others found in that biome, would reward the player with a special piece of armor or weapon.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="FrL09IIHHX8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Lore[/b][/h3][p]Exploration is key to [i]Elements[/i]. Hidden throughout Elemythia are [b]Forgotten Pages[/b] that reveal the history, myths, and mysteries of the world. Some even hint at secrets or future quests. Players who take the time to piece them together will discover deeper layers of the story.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ZPA5Mts-n2g;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h3][b]Villages[/b][/h3][p align="start"]We’ve been hard at work bringing some of the major villages to life. Each village is designed to feel unique, intuitive to explore, and functional for players. We can’t wait for you to experience their charm and personality.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/f53309b67f0f6af76c1370370526471baed13c20.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/ac03bd9a3874dc9daa20a03deb8f7fce6a87c710.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/34fe20b7966af2091387ed0790f021659d65b7db.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/850516f3789f121c8fa42cbe3acbf9f9d0712f5a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/4b263a97f721d965389d117a4a4d41737a139ce2.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Nature Gate[/b][/h3][p]Throughout the world of Elemythia, you’ll encounter monumental gates guarding secrets, new areas, powerful bosses, or unique gear. Our goal was to make these gates feel truly grand and awe-inspiring. Do you think we succeeded?[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/559b5ef0773cbb5d20d519051c771168b609097d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/a1e7b29e630f9b375b1c0420b4a1d23345e87266.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]New Weapons and Gear[/b][/h3][p]We have been hard at work creating gear that feels true to each biome. Most recently we have been working on some of Air weapons include a Katana, One-Handed Sword, and Staff. Each is designed around speed, precision, and flow, with colors and materials that set them apart from other elemental sets.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/99004b44744da48f27ddb58c711ff4bbeae8559b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/a299ab11045932dfaa5939e26695cf83a98ff2ab.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/3ef0698d4bcc7f1908ade6632bc3f61a3c984a3d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/1f1466155d7a12a7a6c418631ee19342abf9371c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Water Armor with Perks[/b][/h3][p]The new Water Armor is now in the game, complete with perks! Each piece grants faster swimming and deeper diving capabilities, letting you explore underwater areas previously out of reach.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/125d1f26f34abda10cb82ac122d5fac551955c77.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/6aa2232b74d529c6cff124ffffb621ae70e097f6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/93ac8f3573def656e29131afe4e0a5a509922cfa.jpg"][/img][/p][previewyoutube="5tDCVROSVgs;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h3]Combat[/h3][p]We have been refining the combat to try and give the player feedback and get it feeling intuitive. Testing how much HP different tiered enemies should have, how much damage different weapons do, speed of attacks to ensure the combat is balanced. This is something the Closed Alpha and future playtests will help with.[/p][previewyoutube="ErrB6xYqLP0;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h3]Building[/h3][p]We have been working on tweaking the building system to make pieces snap together and be more responsive. We want to ensure the building and farming systems in the game integrate seamlessly with the rest of gameplay. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="jeFE8KSe8fQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Mining Improvements[/b][/h3][p]Mining has received some valuable updates! Now, every strike on a mineable resource will yield a portion of the material. Need just one stone? Hit it once and you’re good to go. This streamlines resource gathering while maintaining flexibility.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="gMfrWgnJ4eU;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h3][b]Tree Planting[/b][/h3][p]You can now plant trees, transforming the landscape around your homestead and throughout the world. Need a specific type of wood? Plant the seeds, grow the tree, and harvest it for your crafting needs. This feature not only enhances customization but also adds depth to resource management.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="t0HCHSvj9n8;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h3][b]Quests[/b][/h3][p]We’ve started adding more detailed quests for each village to test the functionality of the quest system and make any necessary tweaks. We want to give players options in how they complete a quest. For example, you could distract guards and steal their keys, or defeat the guards and take the keys, though doing so might alert other enemies in the area.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="3KMVlkWOl3I;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h3][b]Multiplayer[/b][/h3][p]Who knew multiplayer isn't as easy as it seems. We would love to implement online multiplayer, but for now it will just be couch co-op and remote play on Steam. We have been testing multiplayer throughout development to ensure each player has a great experience. This includes chests with items for both players so no one fights over loot.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="TkwT5mkKhqc;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h3][b]Steam Deck[/b][/h3][p]Here is some footage from one of our older builds running on the Steam Deck. We still have some optimization and bugs to work on, but I’m happy to say it is already performing very well and it will only get better.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Es0U4R0HsdE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]What’s Next[/b][/h3][p]Some of the systems currently in development include:[/p][list][*][p]Companion system[/p][/*][*][p]Reputation system[/p][/*][*][p]Journal system[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]A Big Thank You[/b][/h3][p]It has been a long road, but the passion for [i]Elements[/i] has never wavered. This game is ambitious, and while it has taken longer than we first imagined, the progress is real and accelerating. To make sure you do not miss anything, we will be posting more frequent updates here on Steam, both large and small. Please feel free to check out our social links for more frequent updates. We are working to get Elements in your hands as soon as possible.[/p][p]Thank you again for your patience, support, and encouragement. It truly keeps us going. ❤️[/p]

notes.title: NPC, Level Design, Light Armor Update!
notes.notes:
We haven't posted an update for a while, so we are going to do our best to get caught up. We have been keeping our Kickstarter up to date and want to keep everyone of Steam up to date as well.

This was some of our July update for Kickstarter. We will continue to post the other updates and get Steam all caught up asap.

Squirrel and Rabbit NPC - We have got some new textures for the Squirrel and Rabbit NPCs.  They will be in the Air, Ice, Light, and Nature biome. Not all creatures will be in each biome. If you see a creature or NPC type that you have already seen in another biome, their behavior and characteristics will be different. Every creature in Elemythia needs and wants something different, it's up to you to help them find that on your journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/3a11b294e174cd7c079aa70cc9a732115750a236.png[/img]

Fox NPC - We just finished the Fox NPC. Originally, we had planned on a more "cute" fox. But we settled on the Fox being more of a "Warrior". Not every character in this story will be sweet and innocent. Each NPC race will have their own characteristics and motivations. Some will get along with others and some will not. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/bf9d0eba616eedf45cf0b19b40c7e7b77973da14.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=o3IV5L6lb4M;full][/previewyoutube]

Level Design - We have been working on the level design for some of the environments and villages in the Light, Fire, and Nature biomes. For most biomes there will be 3 major villages or towns with multiple smaller villages throughout the biome. 

Squirrel Village - Some work in progress of the Squirrel Village in the Nature Biome.

[previewyoutube=4J9acYhQuLY;full][/previewyoutube]

Light Village - This village is abandoned. It's up to you to find out why and help the villagers return home. Once you do this will unlock new quests, vendors and merchants you can interact with.

[previewyoutube=4bi9TRLE44E;full][/previewyoutube]

Mayan Village - This Mayan inspired village is still very much a work in progress. We are happy with the layout, but still need to add many things to bring this area to life. We also need an NPC type here. Some suggestions we had so far were; Red Pandas, Gorillas, and Lizards. Let us know if you have any suggestions!

[previewyoutube=E8nfwxYaOVo;full][/previewyoutube]

Light Armor - The Rare version of the Light armor is almost finished. It has some Egyptian and Roman inspirations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/0c196c5c9d7b70b2525bfd1b71e3716fa3e7fe90.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/0a48d16054d38526a896f38073758a34cd782ca1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/07eb48d330f64a2fff3c61736a8474c57fa35797.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/f25a762cf0162daaaae3b5a8e4181c305cd68f76.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40183186/327629566d5e87b50b221a6d35963ed6b41b8845.jpg[/img]

Let us know what you think about these updates and what you are looking most forward to in Elements. Have a fantastic day!

notes.title: Elements - June Development Update
notes.notes:
Hey! We just posted a new update on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/findthestones/elements-an-open-world-co-op-rpg-inspired-by-zelda-botw]Kickstarter[/url], so we thought we would let you know what we have been working on too!

UE5 
First off, we switched to UE5! This was a big decision. It took a couple weeks, but we have already seen huge improvements in development speed just by using Level Instancing, Nanite, and World Partition.
 
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/207/697/6c44431ac19a0af4af625e1cedf6e1a5_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1686069247&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=b7af88ba8b34947611c7fbc1b4403c31[/img]

Katana - We added Katanas. Right now we just have one stance, but we are looking at the possibility of having multiple stances for some weapons.

[previewyoutube=2Yl1ZiFmz4E;full][/previewyoutube]

Custom Orcs - Our Custom Orc models are done. We are super happy with how they turned out. The rigging is being worked on right now. Can't wait to start giving them personality with sounds and animations.

[previewyoutube=7GixrP9xDeE;full][/previewyoutube]

Fire Armor - We finished the first rarity of the Fire Armor. I think this is going to be one of my favorite sets. I love all of the little details in this set. And this is the Rare version!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/169/750/b7b181463f9ea5e6d8846b5fb8e0c67a_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1685732072&gif-q=50&q=92&s=bdfeca98950e827585ac4d48f01923a7[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/169/753/3e2ebd7fec62011ad128459bb789c76c_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1685732091&gif-q=50&q=92&s=b080cf64b419732f6aef46f89eaff228[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/169/758/29ce171ca108fc152d0092c24e29f807_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1685732135&gif-q=50&q=92&s=645276393c6c43fa7a98ebd2c38c940c[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/169/765/5d4751402d1dee2ff9106e2a528c4bc4_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1685732162&gif-q=50&q=92&s=af6660d8291c1b4b59af8caa24e12e0d[/img]

Fire Guardian - We have had some progress on the modeling of the Fire Guardian. We are super happy with how it is turning out. This boss will guard the Fire Stone and ensure it doesn't fall into the wrong hands.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/169/719/2e8f78bd6a96ad59f64ff2134f476a2d_original.PNG?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1685731829&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=746cbbd0d01042bbf98df41a669bf407[/img]

Water Weapons - We started working on some weapons for the Water Biome. We took some Polynesian and Atlantean influences and came up with a unique aesthetic.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/207/442/a979ae7b1a110922faae65e04b0f8f0c_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1686068107&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=c0e2c463d30a92488469abbc16dac4a5[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/207/448/d40bd4f868d34040dda4cb1740b89f81_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1686068139&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=189e34c3917047e79f23d7721bc4bc42[/img]

Mythical Pets - We now have our first Mythical Pet. We think he is pretty cute. We will be rigging and animating him soon. And he still needs a name :)

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/207/373/bea15eda552652bd8f1bf28f14c570e4_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1686067880&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=c9a6179bb81dd1cecf584166770293fe[/img]

Language - Elements now has its own language. I didn't realize how complicated making a language was but we connected with a professional. We will share more about the language later, but for now here are the number symbols.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/169/692/70088498055a6fabd77a0827f5a2b3b6_original.PNG?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1685731684&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=033172782b89f33d3985cbb4a81b5fb8[/img]

Please let us know what you are most excited about. We try and read all your feedback. 
Have an amazing weekend!

notes.title: Kickstarter Fully Funded!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

I noticed we had some Kickstarter Backers show up from Steam so I thought I would post an update. We launched a Kickstarter on Jan. 31st and were funded in under 12 hours. As of the time of writing we are now we are sitting at 665% funded and 2,450 backers! 

We are amazed at the positive response. And just like the playtests at PAX, it tells us we are on the right track and that we are building something people are excited about.

If you want to check out the Kickstarter [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/findthestones/elements-an-open-world-co-op-rpg-inspired-by-zelda-botw?ref=50k0fk]here is the link[/url].

On the page you can see some milestones.

There will be a closed Alpha for Backers around September 2023. Then we aim to have a public demo available before launching into Early Access in Q2 of 2024. 

We are so excited to get Elements into everyone's hands. Thank you so much for supporting the game by simply wishlisting and spreading the word.

notes.title: PAX West and New Interview with New Overlords!
notes.notes:
It's been a while since PAX West 2022, but I wanted to share what a great time we had. It's so amazing to have people play and be excited about the game. 

While at PAX West I met Jeff from New Overlords. I sat down with Jeff and Sema and had an amazing chat. We talk about the game and gaming in general. Was a delight to chat with them and I was humbled at the opportunity.

Watch my chat with [url=https://youtu.be/anOfAqlxb24]Jeff and Sema here![/url]

notes.title: Elements received an Epic MegaGrant
notes.notes:
I am so proud and humbled to announce that Elements has received an Epic MegaGrant from Epic Games and Unreal Engine. This all started with a dream and somehow is becoming a reality. It’s amazing to see that Epic has seen enough promise in Elements to support it. I want to thank everyone who has wishlisted, it truly helps. I can’t wait to get this game in your hands. 

Sincerely,
Devon, Wreckit Games

notes.title: Coming to Kickstarter Soon!
notes.notes:
We have decided it would be a good idea to do a Kickstarter. This will give players a chance to pre-purchase the game and help with development. Click [url=http://tinyurl.com/elementskickstarter]Here[/url] to pre-sign up. It really helps and is super appreciated.  No pressure, obviously :)

Right now we have a small team of community members helping with Elements, and I would like to pay them for their efforts. Kickstarter will also give a chance for players to become more involved with the game's development.

It is important to me that a Kickstarter does not take time from development, so the rewards will probably most, if not all be digital. If you have any thoughts on rewards please let me know.

Appreciate ya!
Devon
